### Global Indemnity Group, LLC Names Jessica Buss Chief Executive Officer


11/02/2026


Specialty insurance builder to lead GBLI, Katalyx and Belmont and put the Company’s proprietary technology and national distribution to work


WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Global Indemnity Group, LLC (NASDAQ: GBLI) (“GBLI” or the “Company”) today appointed Jessica E. Buss Chief Executive Officer of GBLI and of its two operating platforms, Katalyx Holdings LLC and Belmont Holdings GX, Inc., effective immediately. Ms. Buss joined GBLI’s Board on October 26, 2026, and remains a director. She succeeds Joseph W. “Jay” Brown, GBLI’s chief executive officer since 2022.


Ms. Buss spent most of her career building specialty insurance businesses. As CEO of GuideOne Insurance, she doubled premiums. She also led Argo Group and Open Lending as CEO. At Open Lending, she also served as Chairman of the Board and chaired its Audit Committee prior to becoming CEO. Earlier, as COO and CFO of Rockhill Insurance, she led its sale to State Auto Mutual for 1.6x book value, then ran State Auto Mutual’s $1.5 billion commercial and specialty division. She is a Certified Public Accountant and holds the NACD Directorship Certification.


Ms. Buss’s mission is to scale a platform Fox Paine spent 23 years assembling and put GBLI’s A-rated paper to work for agents, wholesale partners and new specialty underwriting teams. GBLI’s five insurance carriers carry an “A” (Excellent) rating from AM Best, unbroken for more than 23 years, and its underwriters own a 23-year record of top-quartile loss ratios. GBLI reaches the market through more than 350 wholesale agency offices, 12,000 retail agents and its direct-to-consumer platform. Over the last four years, GBLI developed Kaleidoscope, its proprietary underwriting, policy and data platform, now rolling out to its agency partners. GBLI also equips Kaleidoscope with AI-enabled underwriting that evaluates and prices risks outside traditional binding authority. Ms. Buss leads Katalyx’s expansion into excess and surplus lines managing general agencies across wholesale, retail and direct-to-consumer channels.


“GBLI built what most specialty insurers can only buy or borrow: proprietary underwriting technology, a national agency network and five A-rated carriers behind every policy we write. A platform like that demands a builder, and Jessica builds. She took GuideOne past $1 billion in premium and created a $400 million E&S business along the way. She knows how to make money in specialty casualty, how to attract first-rate talent and how to use technology to grow faster and run leaner than the competition. That is the leader GBLI needs to turn its platform into a far larger franchise. I thank Jay Brown for his vision, his service and his support of this transition,” said Saul Fox, founder and Chairman of GBLI and founder and CEO of Fox Paine & Company, whose affiliate is GBLI’s largest shareholder.


“Four years ago, Saul Fox asked me to move from GBLI’s Board to the CEO’s office and prepare GBLI for a market that rewards disciplined underwriting backed by competitive technology as AI tools mature,” said Mr. Brown. “With Kaleidoscope now rolling out to our agency partners, Jessica takes over at the right time. As a shareholder, I am confident GBLI has a strong, profitable growth path ahead.”


Ms. Buss said, “GBLI has what matters most in specialty insurance: disciplined underwriting, strong carriers, deep agency relationships and technology built for this market’s future. My job is to build on it. I look forward to working with our team, our agents and our partners to make GBLI one of the leading specialty franchises in the country. I also thank Jay for his leadership and for his help with this transition.”


**About GBLI and its subsidiaries**


GBLI is a publicly traded holding company with a diversified portfolio of property and casualty insurance-related operating companies.


Katalyx Holdings LLC includes:


- Four agencies focused on sourcing, underwriting and servicing primary and assumed reinsurance business: Penn-America Insurance Services, LLC; Valyn Re LLC; J.H. Ferguson & Associates, LLC (including Vacant Express); and Collectibles Insurance Services, LLC.
- Two specialized insurance service businesses: Sayata, an AI-enabled digital marketplace and agency for small commercial insurance; and Liberty Insurance Adjustment Agency, Inc., a provider of claims evaluation, adjustment and related services.


Belmont Holdings GX, Inc. consists of five statutory insurance carriers, each rated “A” (Excellent) by AM Best: Penn-America Insurance Company, United National Insurance Company, Penn-Patriot Insurance Company, Diamond State Insurance Company and Penn-Star Insurance Company.


Kaleidoscope Insurance Technologies, Inc. develops GBLI’s proprietary underwriting, policy and data platform, including its AI-enabled underwriting, for Katalyx’s agencies, GBLI’s agency partners, the Belmont insurance carriers, and the Company’s broader digital initiatives.


For more information, visit GBLI’s website at[www.gbli.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mhUg7HbawxsEdThjXD5l5hHK3u72TBcOpd7x09E5r4_k5poE0IzZ1NjFOqJ22XOjEq01qd3OYwvqBkALyevBxQ==) .
